UPDATE users
               SET email = 'deleted-' || id || '@invalid',
                   display_name = 'Deleted user',
                   avatar_url = NULL,
                   bio = NULL,
                   title = NULL,
                   pronouns = NULL,
                   timezone = NULL,
                   preferences = '{}'::jsonb,
                   password_hash = NULL,
                   status = 'suspended',
                   updated_at = NOW()
             WHERE id = $1
